summary: Tested the Dynamik-Werkbank scorecard, search history, Top-5 candidates and apply-candidate. The requested suites pass (33/33). New live API tests pass (11/11, file test_dwb_scorecard_api_iter3.py): the scorecard has every requested field and 8 checks; search_stats is consistent; regimes['2'].top has 5 complete candidates; apply-candidate validation returns 400/404/401 as expected; applying rank 2 returns 200, creates a version, persists applied_rank=2, and the phase params now equal the rank-2 candidate. In the UI, all requested scorecard elements render (rec, WF, MC, MC-test, 8 check chips, reason, fails, regimes, coins, compare, search stats) with no page errors. Top 5 opens, the confirm dialog appears, and applying via the UI shows 'Übernommen ✓ (Version 3)' and then 'Version 4'. Run wb_bcb3ad8b9a has no outlier_variant, so I injected one via a Playwright route mock. The outlier box rendered, and 'Ohne XRP neu optimieren' switched to the refine tab with source dyn_959f0bf9 and XRP deselected; no job started. Two bugs found: (1) after a reload the UI ignores the persisted applied_rank; (2) the 'Ausgangsstand' version snapshot is inconsistent.

minor.issue: Version 1 ('Ausgangsstand (vor der ersten Phasen-Anpassung)') is snapshotted AFTER wb._assign has already written the new candidate into the analysis. Its summary for regime 2 therefore mixes the OLD strategy_params/trade_params (rsi_period 21, rank 1) with the NEW metrics/score (pnl 68.07, score 71.474, from rank 2). Restoring v1 would show wrong metrics. Fix: create the baseline snapshot (or call change_phase's baseline logic) before _assign, or snapshot from the pre-assign doc.
applied_rank is written only to the top-level job regimes.{rid}. It is not written to result.regimes.{rid}, which is what the UI reads (see the integration issue).

ui_bugs.issue: After a reload, the persisted applied_rank is ignored. Repro: the API showed regimes['2'].applied_rank == 2, but the UI marked #1 as 'Aktiv ✓' and showed no apply button on #1. Cause: DynamicWorkbenchResult passes `result.regimes || regimes`, and result.regimes has no applied_rank. Fix: merge the job-level regimes[rid].applied_rank, or also set result.regimes.{rid}.applied_rank in the backend.

integration_issues.issue: canApply is just !!result.dynamic_id, so 'Für Phase übernehmen' buttons show for non-admin users and the click fails with 'Admin-Login erforderlich'. Use isAdmin() from src/auth.js. The component also defines its own authHeaders that bypasses the 1-day expiry check in auth.js (getToken). Import authHeaders from '../auth' instead.

issues: The MetricsRow wraps inside the half-width compare cards, so 'DD 83.3%' drops to a second line by itself.
Cards are ordered robust-first, so #1 (Score 38.5) appears above #2 (Score 71.5). This is confusing without a hint such as 'Rang: robust zuerst, dann Score'.
The DD/PnL badge never shows on the candidates because dd_ratio_pct is null for every top candidate.
'BESTE EINZEL-STRATEGIE · Leichter Aufwärtstrend' shows a regime label, not a strategy name. Better wording: 'Strategie der Phase Leichter Aufwärtstrend allein'.
window.scrollTo does not scroll the modal container. After the click the user lands mid-form instead of at the refine header.
The scorecard and backtest still show the original run's numbers after another candidate is applied. There is no hint that they are stale.

action_items: Make TopCandidates use the persisted applied_rank. Either set result.regimes.{rid}.applied_rank in workbench_apply_candidate (DB and JOBS), or merge job.regimes into result.regimes in DynamicWorkbenchResult.
Create the 'Ausgangsstand' baseline version before wb._assign mutates the analysis assignment, so v1 metrics match its params.
Gate the apply buttons with isAdmin() and reuse authHeaders from src/auth.js (DRY, expiry check).

Optional: explain the robust-first ranking in the Top-5 list; fix the wording of the compare-card baseline label; scroll the modal container on reoptimize; mark the scorecard as 'Stand des Laufs' after an apply.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/dynamic.py (948 lines) and services/dynamic_workbench.py (899 lines) exceed 700 lines. Consider splitting the workbench routes into their own router.
apply-candidate: the phase override is now 'optimized' even after re-applying rank 1. The doc is not byte-identical to its original state (acceptable; versions document it).

success_rate.backend: 100% (33/33 required + 11/11 new live tests); 2 minor logic issues found by inspection
success_rate.frontend: ~90%: all requested elements and flows work; the persisted applied_rank is not reflected after a reload

seed_data_creation: Applying candidates created versions v1-v4 of dyn_959f0bf9 (rank 2 via API, then rank 3 and rank 1 via UI). Regime 2 has been restored to the rank-1 candidate params; applied_rank is now 1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For a UI admin login, set BOTH localStorage admin_token and admin_token_ts=Date.now(); otherwise auth.js getToken clears the token. Run wb_bcb3ad8b9a has no outlier_variant; to test dwb-card-outliers, use page.route to inject scorecard.outlier_variant into /api/dynamic-workbench/active. Regime 3 has no top candidates (rejected). The dyn_959f0bf9 versions endpoint is GET /api/dynamic/{did}/versions -> {versions:[...]}.
